newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC WIN AWAY TO KEEP RANGERS IN SIGHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC WIN AWAY TO KEEP RANGERS IN SIGHT.

text.p: Glasgow Celtic won 2-0 at Dunfermline on Wednesday to close the gap on Scottish premier division leaders Rangers to six points.
Paul McStay put Celtic ahead with a classy strike from just outside the box after 36 minutes.
Portuguese striker Jorge Cadete headed the second four minutes later to continue his remarkable scoring spree.
It was his 15th goal in 10 games and his 25th of the season.
Celtic now have 54 points from 24 matches to Rangers' 60.
